title: A tool returned needing repair is taken out of lending
statement: Whenever a tool is returned with the condition `needs_repair`, report damage on it, with the return note as the damage note (or "Returned needing repair." when there is none). A return recorded as `good` invokes nothing, so it never clears damage (TL-LEND-INV02). The reaction follows the return's commit, in its own transaction: if it fails, the return still stands.
